description.value: Portfolio print from Witold Gordon's illustrations for The Travels of Marco Polo depicting the city of Kinsai. In the foreground, a male figure at left, two female figures at right, the rightmost woman carrying a vase or vessel. Between them, at their feet, a bouquet of flowers. In the middle- and background, aerial view of the walled city of Kinsai. Towers stationed along the wall, several small buildings within. People are shown both inside the buildings and in public spaces. A figure holds a parasol at top, and two figures carry heavy goods strapped to a pole in a public square. At right, a small structure possibly meant for a boat or carriage. A winding river at upper left, a blooming flower with leaves at upper right.

description.value: Portfolio print from Witold Gordon's illustrations for The Travels of Marco Polo depicting nomadic Mongolian peoples (Tartars or Tatars) on a grassy plain. At center, a yurt or similar temporary domestic structure whose exterior is made of decorated fabric, the doorway opened. At the base of the structure, a flagpole with a banner featuring three dogs. A seated trio of figures near the entrance. To the left, an additional standing figure wearing a pointed hat. At left edge, another figure in pointed hat holding a bow and arrow. In the foreground at right, two figures riding bucking horses. In the left foreground, a male figure stands before a horned sheep or cow. In the background, additional horned sheep and horses. description.value: Drawing for book illustration. On cream ground, a stylized design in black and white with strong geometric motifs. A zig-zag pattern at bottom suggests ocean waves, a palm tree or curving flower stem above at left. At center, a figure blows into a large horn resembling a swirled conch shell, raising it above its head. From the horn, five diagonal white lines emerge on black ground, their colors reversing at center left. Above the figure hang two anchor forms suspended in the air. In the background, an abtracted ship, from which emerges a pipe emitting four diagonal lines that extend to the top of the composition, suggesting light or energy. Surrounding these forms are cloud-shaped patterns suggesting smoke or steam. Rectangular black framing line. Graphite notations at bottom and along right edge.

description.value: Portfolio print from Witold Gordon's illustrations for The Travels of Marco Polo depicting a leisure scene with wine and musicians. In the foreground, a nude woman and a clothed man sit upon a blanket at center. A thin stream curves below them. A kneeling figure pours wine into a cup offered by the woman. At left, another female figure holds an additional jar of wine. A kneeling woman near her plays the tambourine. At right, a seated figure plays a stringed instrument with a long neck resembling a tar. A kneeling woman near her plays another tambourine. In the background, at left and right, tall groups of blooming white flowers. Behind them are irregular black forms, possibly suggesting trees or shrubs. In the center background, an elaborate palace-like building with many small towers. On the second level of the building, a large figure of a man with a long beard viewed partially in profile, perhaps playing another stringed instrument. At top, a crescent moon emits beams of light, stars on either side.
